item: make the WAVE/ZONE_REGION join a construction fact: derive one side from the other (shared module vs derive-at-init), spec first, keep t64's comm-proof true by construction
note: Approach (b), strengthened: ZoneGate owns no zone-name list at all. Each WAVE row in init.server.luau carries its region join as a strict-required `region` field (WaveZone type), init.server derives the map (zoneRegions[z.name] = z.region) and hands it to ZoneGate.init. Both facts hold by construction: a zone without a join is a strict type error, a join without its zone cannot be written (map derived from WAVE, never authored). Chose (b) over (a): a shared module would add a file plus two requires and the names would still be written twice; (b) writes them once and is the smaller diff. All 11 pairs byte-equal to t64's recorded join, so t64's comm-proof is now tautological. All t64 negatives preserved in comments (NONE never picked, climbs carry no join, opposed unreachable). Spec landed first in the owning doc (WORLDGEN_MINE.md law 4) plus the ZoneGate module header; gen_df_luau_data.py docstring prose updated to the new join home.
